column1: # Which provider's Collection Log a lookup shows, and whose dates fill Recent (Dylan, 2026-10-27).
# One copy of the rule's answers: the plugin's tests, killclog-api's and the site's run these same rows.
# The grid: the fullest log by distinct items obtained; ties go to Kill Clog's own sync, then TempleOSRS, then RuneProfile.
# Recent: the log whose newest dated item is newest, whichever won the grid; ties go to TempleOSRS, then Kill Clog's
# sync, then RuneProfile. A log with no dates never fills Recent.
# A provider cell is "-" (no log), "<items>" (a log without dates) or "<items>@<newest date>".
